# Bytes for Better Lives

> Bytes for Better Lives (BFBL) is the largest youth-led digital equity nonprofit in Florida. Bytes for Better Lives bridges the digital divide through technology access, digital literacy, and community service. It is a student-led 501(c)(3) nonprofit based in South Florida, helping seniors and children through tech help, digital-literacy and online-safety education, device and supply donations, and a growing network of student-led chapters.

## About

- Tagline: "Technology Should Be for Everyone."
- Legal name: Bytes for Better Lives Corporation, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit, EIN 42-2241292.
- History: started as a student club in 2023, became a nonprofit in 2025, and received IRS 501(c)(3) status in 2026.
- Mission: Bridge the digital divide with patient tech help, practical education, and donations that reach real community needs.
- Vision: We want seniors to feel confident using technology and children to have access to tools that support learning, creativity, and connection.
- Values: Patience, Safety, Accountability, Student Leadership.
- Story: BFBL started with hands-on tech help and community donation drives, then expanded into a chapter model so more students can serve their communities.

## Programs

1. Provide Access: We donate devices to underserved communities, giving students and families the tools they need to learn and connect.
2. Teach Digital Literacy: We teach people of all ages to use technology safely and effectively — from seniors learning new devices to foster children navigating the digital world.
3. Support Education: We provide school supplies and educational resources to underserved students, helping them succeed in school and build the foundation for greater access to technology.
4. Mobilize Community: We establish student-led chapters in communities and neighborhoods, expanding our reach and empowering more young people to bridge the digital divide.

## Impact

- $32,000+ in funds & donations
- 5,700+ people served
- 3,900+ items donated
- 4,000+ service hours
- 216 student volunteers
- 124 events
- 12 chapters
- 6 countries
- 7 digital media centers

## Get involved

- [Donate](https://www.bytesforbetterlives.net/donate.html): give through GoFundMe, Zelle, or PayPal; every dollar funds devices and programs for seniors and students.
- [Start a chapter](https://www.bytesforbetterlives.net/chapters.html#start-chapter): students can launch a Bytes for Better Lives chapter in their own community.
- [Contact](https://www.bytesforbetterlives.net/contact.html): questions, partnerships, volunteering, or starting a chapter.
- Email: bytesforbetterlives@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/bytesforbetterlives/
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/bytes-for-better-lives/
